The '''Shrook''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] clan on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pzob/Legends|Pzob]]. [[Grruna Thu]], the leader, once hired [[Reog's Regiment]], a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], to crush the [[Hakks]] in retaliation of the destruction of their last outpost on [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]], but the mercenaries were overwhelmed in the battle.<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />
